context: Decorative warning above the browser authorization form.
constraints: Remove only this decorative warning; keep the authorization state and recovery actions.

context: Title above the browser authorization form.
constraints: Do not imply that an Agent token can authorize a browser.

current_en: First time? Please use an Auth URL.
en: Paste a browser authorization URL to continue.
context: Instruction above the browser authorization URL input.
constraints: Keep browser authorization separate from Agent access and the launcher Access URL.

context: Primary action applies the saved permission and creates a token for the active tab.
constraints: Retain a tooltip naming the target and permission and explaining token creation; this action can grant direct input.

context: Connection info for the environment selected by the active tab.
constraints: Show the Core or SSH host nearby. This dialog does not restrict grants to the active tab.

context: Copies connection instructions for an external agent.
constraints: Keep the adjacent destination environment visible. Copying does not authorize or mint.
Keep the underlying observe value unchanged; this mode cannot send terminal input.
Keep approval_pending unchanged; input waits for human approval.
Keep direct_active unchanged; do not imply unrestricted file-copy authority.

current_en: Observer can read terminal output. It cannot type.
en: Read terminal output without sending input.
constraints: No promise of access through pause, privacy, expiry, or other gates.

current_en: Approval lets the agent propose input. You approve before it is sent. Remote file copies always need separate approval.
en: Approve each input before it is sent. File copies require separate approval.
constraints: File copies include supported local endpoints; do not describe them as remote-only.

current_en: Full lets the agent type into this terminal without approval. Remote file copies still need separate approval.
en: Allow input without individual approval. File copies still require approval.
constraints: Retain the file-copy exception; do not change other input gates.

context: Advanced action for a tab whose Agent access is already enabled.
constraints: Distinguish token creation from changing the permission or enabling access.

current_en: Permission expired. Renew the token to continue.
en: Token expired. Renew it to continue.
context: Expired token hint in the Agent panel.
constraints: Expiry concerns the token; it does not necessarily reset the selected permission.

context: Token idle countdown in the Agent panel.
constraints: Use the typed remaining idle time; map secondsRemaining to seconds when implementing.

current_en: This will atomically replace an existing regular file ({size}).
context: Warning before approval of a replace-mode Agent file copy.
constraints: Keep the destination path, size, and replacement consequence visible. Atomic publication remains a backend guarantee.

current_en: The displayed destination is the exact keep-both name selected by the backend.
en: Copy to the destination shown; keep the existing file.
context: Warning for a keep-both copy using the canonical destination.
constraints: Do not imply the user can edit the chosen path in this approval dialog.

context: Stops a running transfer before publication.
constraints: Do not merge with Reject, Pause, Disable, Close, or Dismiss; each has a different effect.

current_en: The destination is being published and cannot be stopped
en: Finishing the copy; it can no longer be stopped.
context: Tooltip while transfer publication has crossed the cancellation barrier.
constraints: Keep the stop control disabled; do not imply a finished or failed result.
